admission.justification: One census case asserts the Curator role text's own route clauses — the mounted knowledge_write among the authoring routes, and the sentence that no other route writes knowledge — and a second asserts the role's writer admission by reference to its operation. A role text that denies the route it is told to use sends each curator pass back to a command that refuses its raise.

applicability: The Curator's compiled role text as a curator seat reads it: roles/curator.md and the operation text it names.
conditions: The role text lists knowledge-ingest with this task's leaf contract, the mounted knowledge_write which runs the same writer with the same arguments, and the c-14 foundation under a task contract, then says no other route writes knowledge from this seat.
The commit spelling names both --commit and commit: true.
exclusions: The capsules' word budgets, which do not grow.
Other roles' texts, which this leaf does not own.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_curator_instruction_wording.py and mcp/tests/test_role_capsule_budgets.py, both passed 2026-10-21; the capsules still compile at 3698 / 3142 / 2458 words and no capsule grew

statement: The Curator's own instructions name the mounted knowledge_write among the routes that author knowledge, and say that no other route writes it.
